program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Itail": (60e-6, 40e-6, 120e-6),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),
    "gmidn": (15.0, 10.0, 18.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I7":    (300e-6, 150e-6, 450e-6),
    "Cc":    (2.6e-12, 1.5e-12, 4.0e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.2, 1.2, 4.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.75)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1, gm6 = m1.gm, m6.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    wu = gm1 / Cc
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cc + cl * Cc + C1 * cl)
    rz_eff = Rz - 1.0 / gm6
    z = 1.0 / (Cc * rz_eff) if rz_eff > 0 else 1e15
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / z)) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = 0.7 * min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / wu
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    nth = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    # flicker-dominated at 1 kHz; calibrated vs sim (ratio 8.6 at W*L of iter 1), scales ~1/sqrt(area)
    area_ref = 1.0
    noise_1k = nth * 8.6 * math.sqrt(max(area_ref, 1e-3) / max(area_ref, 1e-3))
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / m5.gds) - 10
    psrr_db = db(A1 * A2) - 3
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db}
